results.note: Uses load_registry() to get parsed IndicatorDefinition objects; the diff deletes the old test_registry_records_talib_fastd_corresponds_to_tradingview_k / test_stochrsi_uses_fastk_period_14... tests that did a raw REGISTRY_PATH.read_text() substring search (which the story explicitly flags as unable to distinguish an entry from the comment at registry.yaml lines 6-7).
Asserts definitions['STOCHRSI'].parameters == {'fastk_period': 14, ...} read via pydantic-parsed .parameters dict (ingest/registry.py:59), not file text.

native_macd_oracle/native_stochrsi_oracle use unittest.mock.patch.object(talib, 'MACD'/'STOCHRSI'/'RSI', wraps=...) and assert call_count==0 — spying on the actual TA-Lib function rather than trusting pandas-ta's talib=False flag.

Explicitly sets talib_enabled=True for both MACD and STOCHRSI oracles and asserts pytest.raises(AssertionError, match='oracle delegated to TA-Lib') — the guard is shown to actually bite, not merely exist.

assert_macd_differential and test_stochrsi_agrees_with_the_independent_tradingview_k_after_warmup (line 179) pull parameters via registered_definition() from the loaded registry, compare only the converged CONVERGED_TAIL_LENGTH=32 tail (post warm-up) within EPSILON=1e-6.

tests/goldens/btc_macd.json and tests/goldens/btc_stochrsi.json exist; ingest/canary.py RESPONSE_MODELS now maps both keys to OkxCandleResponse (canary.py:19-21); this integration test drives assert_registry_coverage over the real load_registry()+golden_keys()+RESPONSE_MODELS, and test_macd_and_stochrsi_reuse_the_strict_okx_candle_response_model (tests/test_macd_stochrsi.py) checks the response-model mapping directly.

Provided deterministic gate 'US-411-C7: exit 0 [uv run pytest -q --no-header -o addopts=]' and the general 'test' gate both report exit 0, i.e. the whole suite (including canary/coverage tests) is green.

note: Reviewed registry.yaml/registry.py/indicators.py/schemas.py/canary.py plus every touched test file directly; the diff removes the old file-text substring checks and replaces them with parsed-object assertions, adds a real TA-Lib spy with a demonstrated-bite negative test, parameterizes the differential oracle from the loaded registry, and wires goldens + response models into the existing registry-coverage integration test. No assertion-free tests or comment-only fixes found; all criteria are backed by concrete, named tests plus the given green full-suite exit code.
